oneLine: Infinx Tech plans an IPO to raise $300 million and appoints three bankers.

sources.title: Infinx Tech Plans $300-m IPO in India, Appoints Three Bankers

synopsis: Healthcare IT platform firm Infinx Technology Solutions has appointed Kotak Mahindra Capital, Nomura, and Avendus to manage its proposed $300 million initial public offering in India. The company, which is backed by KKR and Norwest Venture Partners, is targeting a listing in FY28 and may potentially combine a fresh issue of shares with an offer for sale. Infinx was founded in 2012 by brothers Sandeep and Jaideep Tandon and provides AI-powered healthcare revenue cycle management solutions. KKR acquired a significant minority stake in the company in 2024 through its Asian Fund IV, with Norwest also participating.
